insights.one_liner: Dutch business software (ERP) company with a 2030 growth plan, new leadership and a fresh acquisition; an IND sponsor.

culture.text: Calls itself a people-first community with a high-performance team that values staff being their authentic selves.
A software company founded in 1980, headquartered in Dordrecht.

open.text: UNIT4 Business Software Netherlands B.V., Unit4 Group Holding B.V. and UNIT4 MKB Software B.V. are IND recognised sponsors.

growth.text: Is buying French resource-management platform Napta to grow in professional services.

Gives mid-market customers commitment-free access to AI features.
